Features

Real Users. Real Results. Real ROI.

Real users, real businesses, incredible returns. See how xTool F2 Ultra UV is fueling growth for creators just like you.

"Paid for itself in 2.5 months: 6x Faster Engraving."

As an engineer, efficiency is everything. UV replaces the 1-hour messy coating, engraving, and washing process with 10-minute direct engraving. This efficiency boost handled a 102-piece wedding order effortlessly. The machine paid for itself in 2.5 months!

“3.75x Sales Growth: From Garage to Warehouse”

Since going full-time, UV became my growth engine. Adding premium details to our signature wedding bundles surged monthly sales by 3.75x. We've expanded from a small garage corner to the whole space and are moving to a professional warehouse soon!

“20X Markup Secret: High-Profit 3D Inner Glass Engraving”

3D inner engraving is a new profit tier. We transform crystals into $40-$75 premium memorial pieces. At pop-up markets, it attracts huge crowds fascinated by watching the live “magic” inside the glass, securing our growth as a high-margin brand.

“Zero Charring: Cleanest Wood & Glass Results”

In my home studio, quality is everything. While CO2 leaves burn marks, UV delivers a clean “frosty” look on glass and wood with zero charring. I now offer high-end memorial gifts, like photo-etched hearts, that customers truly cherish forever!

Grow Your Business with High-Margin Crystal Engraving

Create the intricate 3D crystal keepsakes trending on Etsy with F2 Ultra UV, perfect for weddings, graduations, championships, and more.

Right from the First Piece. Reliable Every Batch.

3D Embossing on 2mm Brass Coin
See the Extreme Engraving Effect. Match Your Needs.
Only F2 Ultra and F1 Ultra can do 3D embossing. The only difference is power and efficiency.
Color Engraving on Stainless Steel
From Muted to Magnificent. Find Your Perfect Hue.
Color results from most vivid to less: F2U>F1U>F2
Metal Cutting Capability on Brass
Different Power. Clear Differences in Metal Cutting.
Cutting limits by model: F2 Ultra (2 mm brass / stainless steel / aluminum) > F1 Ultra (0.4 mm brass, 0.3 mm stainless steel, 0.2 mm aluminum) > F2 & F2 Ultra UV (no metal cutting).
Engraving on Glass & Crystal
Surface to Inner Engraving, Explore Every Possibility.
F2 Ultra UV excels at glass with crisp surface marks and stunning 3D internal engraving, delivering the highest clarity and consistency. Other F-series models are limited to surface engraving, and their results on transparent glass are noticeably less clear.

FAQ

F2 Ultra UV delivers an all-in-one, commercial-grade solution for high-speed, premium glass customization.

  • Premium results that boost product value: Smooth, uniform, crack-free finishes — even on thin glass — help you create high-end products with higher margins.
  • High-efficiency production for scalable business: No pre-treatment or cleaning needed. Engraving speeds up to 15,000 mm/s, with batch and rotary support for more SKUs.
  • More profit and flexibility than outsourcing: Bring production in-house for faster sampling, quicker turnaround, and greater control over trends and costs.
  • Complete glass processing in one machine: Supports 3D inner engraving, fine surface engraving, embossing, and precision cutting.
  • Higher pricing power and premium appeal: Compared to common materials like wood or acrylic, glass products instantly feel more upscale — and customers are willing to pay more for that premium finish.
  • Rapidly growing demand across high-value markets: From weddings and events to corporate gifting, souvenirs, and luxury drinkware, glass personalization is expanding into more profitable applications.
  • Less competition, stronger differentiation: While many businesses stay focused on traditional engraving materials, upgrading into glass helps you stand out with a premium product line.
  • A long-term, scalable profit driver: Glass is more than a new material — it’s a business upgrade toward higher-margin customers and sustainable growth.

Yes —5W is the golden power level for desktop UV laser systems.

With UV lasers, performance is not driven by wattage alone. UV uses short wavelengths and high-energy photons to break molecular bonds with minimal heat. This “cold processing” delivers far higher energy density and precision than traditional heat-based lasers.

F2 Ultra UV’s 5W fully covers professional needs:

  • High-speed efficiency: Up to 15,000 mm/s, with 3D inner engraving typically using only around 60% power output, leaving extra capacity.
  • Maximum desktop precision: Higher wattage does not significantly improve fine details.
  • Widest material compatibility: Excellent for glass, plastics, acrylic, and more, with practical cutting support.
  • Best long-term value: Premium optics and strict quality control ensure reliable commercial performance.

Compared to other UV laser systems, F2 Ultra UV leads in ease of use, automation, speed, scalability, and inner engraving quality:

  • Effortless 3D inner engraving: One-click 3D model generation from images or text, with smart presets and Atomm’s rich project library to guide every step.
  • Dual 48MP camera automation: Autofocus and 0.2mm positioning accuracy for consistent batch production.
  • Fastest productivity: Up to 15,000 mm/s, with inner engraving algorithms up to 180% faster than standard systems.
  • Greater flexibility: Dual field lenses, the largest working area, and conveyor support for more applications.
  • Finer, more uniform results: Exclusive stabilization and power compensation ensure clean, even engraving across large areas.

It includes:

  • 1 × Inner engraving lens
  • 1 × Riser
  • 1 × K9 glass block (for testing/calibration)
  • 3 × Inner engraving calibration cards

Inner engraving and surface engraving require different lenses. This pre-calibrated pack lets you switch modes easily and accurately.
